svg.aria-label: RTRP AWS architecture: GitHub Actions builds and deploys six ECS Fargate services behind an ALB; Trade API, Risk Engine, ML Inference, and Alerting exchange events over an Amazon MQ RabbitMQ broker, persist to RDS Postgres and ElastiCache Valkey, and are scraped by Prometheus and visualized in Grafana; Alerting publishes to SNS for email notification.
